And there was talk.
Mar 2026 • Couples
While in Southeast Asia, we developed an unspoken rule for ourselves: “The better the place looks, the worse and more expensive the kitchen.” The proudly named Alex Restaurant was no exception. For a price 30% higher than any of the surrounding cafes, we got what we didn't get in any of the places visited:
- uncovered onions
- not peeled cucumbers
- not gutted shrimp 
- cold meat mixed with hot rice
And other gastronomic experiences.
As a result, it is better to walk to any of the surrounding diners, where you will be fed cheaper and, most importantly, taste better
